Emma — a direct note from Vector, with Jack's backing.

Tonight's round: 5 products checked, 1 card, 4 NOT FOUND. After your round, the same products were searched again the same evening: Geedel grater clip FOUND, Conair fabric shaver clip FOUND in about 3 minutes inside TikTok's own search, Command hangers clip FOUND. The reel went out with all 5 products. Jack also searched himself tonight and found plenty of videos. The clips exist — the search has to go deeper before NOT FOUND is written.

From the next round, a NOT FOUND is only accepted after ALL of these:
1. Search INSIDE TikTok (the app's own search), not only web/Google results.
2. Exact product name PLUS at least 3 variants (short name / brand + key word / name + demo or review).
3. Scroll at least 30 results per term.
4. Check the brand/seller official account.
5. Your NOT FOUND message must list every term tried — it has to show this full protocol.

If a product is still hard after all that, say so EARLY in your window, not at the end. One best clean card per product is the job: dig first, report second.
